findings.summary: The artifacts line misdescribes three of the logs it cites: logs/queue-verbs.log records 13 passed at revision 15e64a0b5, before the two cases this window adds existed, and is cited as 15 passed; logs/identity-after.log records 4 failed, 21 passed, EXIT=1 — including the KeyError at tests/test_run_verbs_share_one_identity_grammar.py:168 this window repairs — and is cited as all passing; and logs/census-after.log ends at 22 dots with no summary and no EXIT= line, so promotion cannot read its status. The facts are true (I re-ran the head and got 15 passed, and the census files pass), but the receipt a promotion gate reconciles against says otherwise, which is the defect this record exists to prevent.

The fourteen-file after-arm names revision 15e64a0b5 — the first commit — so the recorded zero delta predates bad9d68f5, which is where reckon/mcp.py and the two census suites change; the manifest presents these arms as the branch arm without naming their revision, so the delta as recorded covers only the pre-window tree.

test_each_crew_tool_action_returns_its_cli_verb_document compares tool == cli on a missing run for all three actions, so read_pointer raises before priority, time_budget, backend or model is ever read: the assertion holds even if reckon/mcp.py:2443-2448 stops forwarding any one of those six parameters. It guards action routing, not argument forwarding, which is the half of the wiring this node adds.

The new parity test re-implements the capability the repository already owns at tests/test_crew_tool_carries_the_write_verbs.py:70-169, whose CASES table is exactly an action-to-CLI-verb parity census called through reckon.mcp._crew, and it repeats this file's own :374 test with one call layer added; three rows appended to the owner's CASES table would have covered the same ground and kept one census rather than two.

The retention-sweep row belongs to no verb this node adds; it repairs a base-revision census failure in passing and lands in the same commit as the three queue rows, so the diff carries a change the goal does not imply and a reviewer cannot tell this node's census work from an unrelated repair.
